newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to up 0.05.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to up 0.05.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open unchanged to 0.05 cent firmer Friday, dealers said, with the market expected to remain in its recent trading range.

Thursday, the most-active October contract closed 0.05 cent lower at 11.06 cents a lb after trading from 11.20 to 11.04 cents. Second-position March ended off 0.01 cent at 11.24 cents, while the back months eased 0.02 and 0.04 cent.

Traders said a move below 11.00 cents in October could pressure the contract to its next downside target of 10.80 cents. Speculative buying would emerge over 11.25-11.30 cents, they said, pegging the next upside target at 11.40 cents.

LIFFE white sugar futures were tightly mixed on Friday with activity focused on the August contract ahead of expiry. At 0848 EDT/1248 GMT, LIFFE spot August stood 90 cents lower at $320.30, while October rose 60 cents to $315.30.
